arc.fallback: Great Sea Battle of Kirigakure Arc

description.fallback: Having left the village, Hebiichigo keeps telling herself it was her only choice to survive, insisting she didn't make a mistake. She hears Buntan and Kyohō calling out to her, knowing the route she'd have taken. Buntan is annoyed at the moment she chose to defect, Kyohō knows she feels lonely because they didn't go with her.
